mapper.sql: CASE WHEN c.likes_user IS NULL OR c.likes_user = '' OR c.likes_user = '0' THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(c.likes_user) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.likes_user, ',', '')) + 1 END AS likes

choose.when: CASE WHEN FIND_IN_SET(#{param.currentUserId}, c.likes_user) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked

mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, , , CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN 'AI助手' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN '' ELSE u.avatar END AS avatar, CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN 0 ELSE u.ex1 END AS user_level, CASE WHEN c.reply_user_id = -100 THEN 'AI助手' ELSE ru.nickname END AS reply_user_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment rc WHERE rc.parent_id = c.id AND rc.deleted = 0) AS reply_count FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_user_info u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user_info ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{param.postId} AND c.deleted = 0
AND c.parent_id = #{param.parentId}
AND c.parent_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, , , CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN 'AI助手' ELSE u.nickname END AS nickname, CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN '' ELSE u.avatar END AS avatar, CASE WHEN c.user_id = -100 THEN 0 ELSE u.ex1 END AS user_level, CASE WHEN c.reply_user_id = -100 THEN 'AI助手' ELSE ru.nickname END AS reply_user_nickname FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_user_info u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user_info ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.user_id WHERE c.parent_id = #{param.parentId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.*, , 0 AS is_liked, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.ex1 AS user_level, CASE WHEN c.reply_user_id = -100 THEN 'AI助手' ELSE ru.nickname END AS reply_user_nickname, p.title AS post_title, p.media AS post_cover FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_user_info u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user_info ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.user_id LEFT JOIN t_post p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
